consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the standout moment of the show was the long-awaited return of 'Death Don't Have No Mercy,' which was performed for the first time in 19 years. The overall energy of the performance was praised, with many noting Jerry Garcia's exceptional guitar work and the band's strong cohesion throughout the night.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 29 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The excitement surrounding the rare performance of 'Death Don't Have No Mercy' and the overall strong energy of the show contributed to a positive sentiment despite some minor criticisms.
